workflows.name: Assistant linked-device key lifecycle
workflows.expected: Parent/adult/child role parity, one-time display, copy failures, scoped revoke, issuer membership and in-flight revocation.

workflows.name: Generic speaker and Shortcut setup and answers
workflows.expected: Setup, bearer/body token, missing or revoked links, speech responses and rate limits; provider labels do not establish integration.

workflows.name: Alexa setup and session responses
workflows.expected: Provider setup and account linking, token locations, launch/help/stop/empty slots, cards and session closure. No provider setup artifacts are supplied by this incoming change.

workflows.name: Spoken family schedule and task queries
workflows.expected: Today, tomorrow, next event, overdue tasks, timezone/DST and all-day events.

workflows.name: Assistant voice capture to calendar
workflows.expected: Capture permission, interpretation, verified calendar persistence, repeated and lost responses before spoken success.

workflows.name: Assistant voice capture to notes
workflows.expected: Capture permission, interpretation, verified note persistence, repeated and lost responses before spoken success.

workflows.name: Assistant voice capture to shopping
workflows.expected: Capture permission, first-list creation, exact shopping persistence, repeated and lost responses before spoken success.

workflows.name: Assistant voice capture to tasks
workflows.expected: Capture permission, interpretation, verified task persistence, repeated and lost responses before spoken success.

workflows.name: Assistant usage and audit visibility
workflows.expected: Bounded utterance logging, family isolation, last-used state, and distinction between that state and event history.

workflows.name: Family library feed subscription and import
workflows.expected: RSS/Atom URL validation, redirects/DNS/MIME/size guards, parsing, owned items and shared document-fetch regressions.

workflows.name: Family library feed refresh and removal
workflows.expected: Retained errors and retries, GUID collisions, updates, unsubscribe cascade, and book-feed item classification.

workflows.name: Family library manual books and audio
workflows.expected: Title/book/page/audio input, invalid URLs, persisted readback and player selection.

workflows.name: Family library personal bookmarks and progress
workflows.expected: Personal saved/position/completed state versus shared feed ownership, foreign item/feed IDs and role matrix.

workflows.name: Family library playback and resume
workflows.expected: Resume, pause, seek fifteen seconds, media errors, time/end events, unmount writes and duplicate player instances.

workflows.name: Family library offline audio storage and playback
workflows.expected: Request flag, actual Cache API bytes, offline consumption/removal, CORS, quota/device storage and family/account changes.

workflows.name: New-family inbound address provisioning
workflows.expected: Existing-address preservation, unique-name contention, optional-provisioning timeout/retry, completion and manual fallback.

workflows.name: Reserved mailbox namespace and provider ingress
workflows.expected: Alias normalization, reserved names, legacy addresses, provider MX/forwarding setup and signed email/SMS/voice/transcription ingress.
